basic_info.description: Welcome to Daly City's historic Westlake District! This charming house is a part of Bay Area and American post-war, classic mid-century architectural history. With proximity to convenient shopping such as Home Depot and the Westlake Shopping Center, abundant restaurants, banks, public busses, SFO, BART and major freeways, San Francisco and the peninsula are just a short distance away.  This home has modern upgrades yet still maintains the originality and vintage touches of the past.  A low maintenance back yard offers homegrown lemons, roses and no-maintenance required for the artificial front lawn.  Families will appreciate highly rated schools such as Marjorie H. Tobias Elementary, Benjamin Franklin Intermediate and Westmoor High schools. Central heating will warm three cozy bedrooms upstairs with an updated bath, large living room with fireplace, dining room and kitchen with small breakfast nook. Basement has laundry facilities, separate three rooms, and updated bath!  Private parking is available in your tandem garage, private driveway, and on the street!
